test_title: PYST 9: SSC CGL 2024 - English (Held On: 11 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that will improve the underlined part of the given sentence.

When I __saw him__, I will ask him to return the book he borrowed.
solution:
The correct answer is '**see him**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in the future tense, and the correct form of the verb to use is "**see him**".

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *When I see him__, I will ask him to return the book he borrowed.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Shall see him**: This is not commonly used in modern English.
 
• **Have seen him**: This suggests a past action completed before the present.
 
• **Had seen him**: This suggests a past action completed before another past action.
